repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate adds an `if (diff < 0) { diff = t1 - t2 }` block that folds the difference to an absolute value before the final check. The IR checks `t2 - t1 >= 3` (signed difference), meaning it only triggers on a temperature rise of at least 3 degrees. The candidate incorrectly triggers on a drop of 3 degrees (e.g., 3 to 0) because it converts the negative difference to positive. Evidence F2 confirms the IR emitted no action while the candidate did.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value folding logic to preserve the IR's signed arithmetic requirement. The final condition now strictly matches the IR's `t2 - t1 >= 3`.
